note: `tent` takes the same cell root, w^{-1} exp((a_m/a_k)^4 q_k + 6), with `treasury` for q_k; the residual form `density_price` has the abstract `u+c+d b` and a factor a_r^e in place of 6, a difference of constants.

refine (Stock.spacer ‖W‖ g w K (norm_nonneg _) hk Fintype.card_pos ?_).trans (by change Real.exp g/w ≤ Real.exp (g-_); rw [Real.exp_sub,Real.exp_log hk])
   have he : (Fintype.card (Site (C.side k p)):ℝ)*Vac.treasury C.path.levels k+K* (6:ℝ)=K*g:=by
       rw [Stock.tallies C.S m k p]; unfold K g; ring
   exact hj.trans_eq (congr_arg Real.exp he)

proof_context.conclusion: `Stock.spacer` takes the `K`-th root, `tallies` converts site to cell count to give `exp g / w`, `g = (a_m/a_k)^4 treasury + 6`.

theorem density_price (hn : m ≤ N) (h : C.Makes) (F : Config G (C.side N p) → ℂ)
    (L : GridLane C m N p) (hl : L.Works r) {W u c d b : ℝ}
    (he : (L.sites r).Radial (fun _ => W) u c d b) (hW : 0 < W) (hf : ∀ i, L.load i=e)
    (hq : ∀ i,L.uses i=(center C.S p hn 0).copy i F) :
    (center C.S p hn 0).rootTest (C.beta N p) F ≤
      Real.exp (((C.S.a m/C.S.a r)^4)*Vac.treasury C.path.levels r + (u+c+d*b)) / ((C.S.a r ^ e)*W) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For an arbitrary `F` with a lane of radius `W`, root test `≤ exp ((a_m/a_r)^4 treasury + (u+c+d b)) / (a_r^e W)`.
